nodes.npc: Hi! Do you have a question?

replies.en: Yes. What's our homework for today?
Yes. I was sick yesterday. Did I miss anything?
replies.zh: 有，我昨天生病，有錯過什麼嗎？

nodes.npc: Read page ten and write down five new words.
nodes.npcZh: 讀第十頁，寫下五個新單字。

nodes.npc: Yes. We learned about animals. Please read page ten and write down five new words.
nodes.npcZh: 有，我們學了動物。請讀第十頁，寫下五個新單字。

replies.en: OK, I'll do that. When is it due?
replies.zh: 好，我會做。什麼時候要交？

nodes.npc: It's due on Friday. Do you need anything else?
nodes.npcZh: 星期五交。還需要什麼嗎？

replies.en: Yes. Could I borrow a pencil, please? I forgot mine.
replies.zh: 要，可以借我一支鉛筆嗎？我忘了帶。

replies.en: No, thanks. I think I'm OK.
replies.zh: 不用了，謝謝，應該沒問題了。

replies.en: Can you borrow me a pencil?
replies.zh: 你可以借我一支鉛筆嗎？

reaction.en: Borrow you a pencil? Hmm, do you mean you want to borrow one from me?
reaction.zh: Borrow you 一支鉛筆？嗯，你是想跟我借一支吧？

replies.explain: borrow 是「借入」，lend 是「借出」。跟別人借東西要說 Can I borrow...? 或 Can you lend me...?，不能說 Can you borrow me...?

nodes.npc: Sure, here you go. Please give it back after class.
nodes.npcZh: 好，給你。下課後請還給我。

replies.en: OK, I will. Thank you, Ms. Lee.

nodes.npc: Great. So, what do you need to do for homework?
nodes.npcZh: 很好。那你作業要做什麼？

replies.en: Read page ten and write down five new words.
replies.zh: 讀第十頁，寫下五個新單字。

nodes.npc: Good. See you in class tomorrow!
